title: Inconsistent lint attr trio across crates
description:
14 crates use `#![warn(missing_docs, rust_2018_idioms)]` as the standard warn set. 5 crates (pkix-aia, pkix-aia-http, pkix-lint-cabf, pkix-truststore-system, pkix-truststore-pkcs11) split the lints into a different shape: `#![deny(rust_2018_idioms, unreachable_pub)]` + `#![warn(missing_docs)]`. The 3 differing crates add `unreachable_pub` and promote `rust_2018_idioms` from warn to deny, while the 14 standard crates do not. pkix-difftest uses `#![warn(clippy::pedantic)]` only, which is reasonable given it is dev tooling.

Impact: a contributor working in one crate and copy-pasting the lint header to a new crate gets different lint strictness depending on which crate they copied from. New crates may miss the `unreachable_pub` lint, or conversely be surprised by `deny`-level `rust_2018_idioms` that is only `warn`-level elsewhere.

Crates with the divergent shape: pkix-aia, pkix-aia-http, pkix-lint-cabf, pkix-truststore-system, pkix-truststore-pkcs11. All other non-difftest crates use the standard shape.
